name: google-mcp
description: Gmail + Google Calendar + Google Chat + Google Drive + Meet + Workspace directory for any Google account. No gcloud required — uses OAuth2 refresh tokens stored locally. Supports multiple accounts simultaneously.
author: Charlie Graham / Second Coffee

tools.name: gmail_search
tools.description: Search Gmail messages

tools.name: gmail_read
tools.description: Read a full Gmail message

tools.name: gmail_create_draft
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft

tools.name: calendar_list_events
tools.description: List upcoming calendar events

tools.name: calendar_get_event
tools.description: Get a calendar event's full details

tools.name: list_chat_spaces
tools.description: List Google Chat spaces, group chats and DMs

tools.name: search_chat_messages
tools.description: Search or browse Google Chat messages across spaces

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Google Chat space (writes)

tools.name: drive_list_files
tools.description: List or search Drive files, including shared drives

tools.name: drive_get_changes
tools.description: Drive change feed since a stored watermark

tools.name: drive_read_file
tools.description: Read a Drive file's contents as text (Docs export)

tools.name: drive_create_folder
tools.description: Create a Drive folder (writes)

tools.name: drive_upload_file
tools.description: Create a Drive file, optionally converting markdown to a Google Doc (writes)

tools.name: drive_update_file
tools.description: Update a Drive file in place, keeping its ID and URL (writes)

tools.name: drive_list_comments
tools.description: List comment threads on a Drive file

tools.name: drive_get_activity
tools.description: Drive Activity: who edited/commented/renamed/shared, with actors

tools.name: directory_lookup_people
tools.description: Resolve Workspace people by id, search, or list the directory

tools.name: meet_list_conference_records
tools.description: Past Meet conferences and who actually attended

tools.name: meet_get_transcript
tools.description: Transcript of a past Meet conference, if transcription was on

tools.name: list_chat_members
tools.description: List members of a Chat space, group chat or DM
